serie-r.name: Serie R
serie-r.technology: Metallised reflective layer (aluminium) — acts like a mirror against solar heat
serie-r.description: Metallised coating (aluminium) — effectively reflects solar heat like a mirror. Available in Silver, Grey, Bronze, Blue, Green, Gold and other tints.
serie-r.idealFor: Residential and commercial buildings with strong solar exposure

arm-platinum-spectrum.name: ARM Platinum / Spectrum
arm-platinum-spectrum.technology: Nano-ceramic coating — blocks solar energy through fine, densely applied particles rather than reflecting it, resulting in a brighter, more transparent look.
arm-platinum-spectrum.description: Dense particle coating — blocks solar energy instead of reflecting it, resulting in particularly bright and transparent glass.
arm-platinum-spectrum.idealFor: Shopfronts, car dealerships, retail — where clarity matters

safety-serie.name: Safety Serie
safety-serie.description: Increased impact resistance — holds glass shards together on breakage and deters intrusion. Available in 4 / 7 / 8 / 12 / 13 mil (100–336 µm).
safety-serie.idealFor: Ground-floor and shopfront windows, security-sensitive areas

uv-protection-clear.name: UV Protection Clear
uv-protection-clear.description: Up to 99.9% UV protection at maximum clarity — ideal for premium displays.

howLong.a: Most residential jobs finish in a few hours. Larger commercial façades are scheduled by area and access — we confirm timing after the on-site measurement.

removeable.q: Can the film be removed later?
removeable.a: Yes. Professionally installed film can be removed without replacing the glass. Residue is cleaned as part of a removal service.

outdoorIndoor.q: Is the film applied inside or outside?
outdoorIndoor.a: Most solar and security films are installed on the interior glass surface for durability and weather protection. We specify the correct face for each product.

darkness.q: Will my rooms become too dark?
darkness.a: Not if we choose the right VLT. Options range from 5% (strong privacy) to 95% (near-clear). We match tint to your daylight and privacy goals.

warranty.a: Manufacturer film warranties apply according to the selected series. Installation workmanship is covered by City-Ton — details are confirmed in your quote.

pricing.a: Quotes are project-based: film type, area in m², access conditions and any security thickness. There is no flat rate.

partnerModels.q: What partnership models do you offer?
partnerModels.a: We work as a subcontractor for construction firms, as an installation partner for glass workshops, and as a long-term partner for facility and property management.

responseTime.q: How quickly do you respond to inquiries?
responseTime.a: We aim to respond within one business day and can usually schedule a site visit within the same week.

securityCert.a: Safety Serie films are engineered for shatter protection. The exact certification standard is confirmed per product line — ask us for the current test documentation.
